records.title: Daily goal operations review
checklist: Record what changed since the previous review.
Record active blockers and required approvals.
Record validation that needs to be run.
required_evidence: Current-day review note or progress-review update.
Validation output when a status changes.
Evidence record when the review proves a claim.
records.completion_rule: Mark performed only when a real daily review is run with current-day evidence.
records.next_action: Use the review log for each real daily review occurrence; do not backfill a fake review.

records.title: Weekly goal and PR queue review
checklist: Update weekly priorities only with current evidence.
required_evidence: Completed weekly-priorities record for the actual week.
Updated blocker or task evidence when queue status changes.
Validation output for any changed structured records.
records.completion_rule: Mark performed only when the weekly template is completed for the current week.
records.next_action: Use weekly review logs only for actual weeks and keep unresolved repository hygiene blockers visible until resolved.

records.title: Monthly strategic goal review
checklist: Review roadmap phases and architecture alignment.
Review AI Core, Command Center, public readiness, and release readiness.
Update deferred work and next safe actions.
required_evidence: Completed monthly-review record for the actual month.
Updated milestone or backlog records when direction changes.
Evidence records for any new completion or validation claim.
records.completion_rule: Mark performed only when the monthly review is completed for the current month with evidence-backed updates.
records.next_action: Use monthly review logs only for actual months and keep readiness blockers visible until resolved.
